# Aeroblend Airbrush Makeup Foundation (O35)

## Flawless, Natural-Looking Coverage
Achieve a smooth, even finish with the Aeroblend Airbrush Makeup Foundation. This water-based formula applies through the Aeroblend airbrush system and delivers natural-looking coverage that holds up through the day, so you can spend less time touching up and more time out and about.

## Long-Lasting Wear for Every Skin Type
Stay put from morning to evening. This waterproof foundation resists sweat and is designed to last up to 10 hours. It suits dry and oily skin alike, and its soft-focus pigments make it a strong choice for HD photography and video.

## Gentle Formula for Sensitive Skin
Made without fragrance, parabens, silicones, or petroleum-derived ingredients, this foundation is formulated for sensitive skin. Botanical and mineral ingredients, including kaolin, lavender, and jojoba, help hydrate and soothe your complexion while you wear it.

## Easy to Apply, Easy to Match
Blend your makeup in minutes with the airbrush application. A wide shade range helps you find a tone that matches your skin.

## Generous Size, Secure Bottle
Each 30 ml (1 fl oz) bottle gives you more product than many airbrush sample sizes, and the secure cap helps reduce spills.

## Find Your Perfect Shade
Choose your shade today and bring a flawless, long-lasting finish to your routine. Add the Aeroblend Airbrush Makeup Foundation to your cart now.
